description: Defines the CpuSet class used to model a set of CPUs, including parsing sysfs files to determine CPU affinity, intersecting CPU sets, and counting CPUs in the set.

classes.name: CpuSet
classes.description: A helper class to model a set of CPUs, with methods for parsing sysfs CPU list files, intersecting sets, and counting CPUs.

methods.name: CpuSet
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CPU set mask to zero.

methods.name: ParseSysFile
methods.description: Parses a sysfs file descriptor to extract CPU IDs and populate the CPU set.

methods.name: IntersectWith
methods.description: Intersects this CPU set with another CPU set.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of CPUs in the set.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets the bit corresponding to a CPU index in the mask.
